mapper.select:
select task_id as taskId, #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as second, avg(tx_bps) as txBps from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in
#{record}
and create_time <= #{item.endTime} and create_time > #{item.startTime} group by task_id
order by taskId,statisticalTime

select count(1) as taskNum,sum(success_count) as successCount,sum(error_count) as errorCount, sum(success_count+error_count) as runnedCount,count(distinct(node_id)) as totalNode, (SELECT COUNT(1) from mp_flow_task_task where task_status='1' and scene_id=#{sceneId}) as runningTask, (SELECT COUNT(distinct(node_id)) from mp_flow_task_task where task_status='1' and scene_id=#{sceneId}) as runningNode from mp_flow_task_task t where scene_id=#{sceneId}
select min(create_time) as firstTime from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId})

select #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as offsetValue, #{item.offsetUnit} as offsetUnit, sum(tx_bps) as txBps, sum(tx_pps) as txPbs, CAST(avg(latency) as int) as latency, CAST(avg(jitter) as int) as jitter, sum(total_tx_L2) as totalTxL2, sum(total_tx_L1) as totalTxL1, sum(total_pps) as totalPps, sum(total_rx) as totalRx, sum(queue_full) as queueFull, sum(drop_rate) as dropRate from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId}) and create_time=( select max(create_time) from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId}) and create_time <= #{item.endTime} and create_time > #{item.startTime} )
order by statisticalTime

select node_name as nodeName,sum(tx_bps) as txBps from mp_flow_task_task t,mp_flow_task_record r where t.id=r.task_id and scene_id=#{sceneId} and task_status='1' and r.create_time=( select max(r.create_time) from mp_flow_task_task t,mp_flow_task_record r where t.id=r.task_id and scene_id=#{sceneId} and task_status='1') group by nodeName order by txBps desc
